title: Facet coverage and source-linked answer assembly
status: Illustrative toy example, not a measured result or a claim about a deployed system
query: How are cached results reused and evicted?

passages.text: Old entries are removed at capacity.

selectionRule: Choose one source per facet. For this example, the earliest document ID breaks a tie.

answerClauses.text: Old entries are evicted at capacity.

relationshipPlan.centralRelationship: Each selected matrix row preserves its source ID into one answer clause, covering both query facets without selecting the duplicate passage.
relationshipPlan.matrixMark: One binary cell indicates whether the row passage covers the column facet; these are stipulated labels, not measured scores.
relationshipPlan.rowIdentity: d1 through d4 remain in input order and align with matrix rows.
relationshipPlan.selectedState: Selected rows use a plum accent and explicit selection marks; coverage uses 1/0 so grayscale remains interpretable.
relationshipPlan.edges: Native directed connectors link visible selected-row boundaries to their supported answer-clause boundaries. No edge from d2 or d4 to the answer.
relationshipPlan.scope: The four documents are supplied candidates; retrieval and learned scoring are outside this illustrative example.
relationshipPlan.asset: One separately generated flat document-collection pictogram introduces the candidate collection. It contains no IDs, text, arrows or semantic data.

reference.observation: The inspected CLIP figure couples concrete inputs with stable row/column identities and a matrix. Apply only the identity/correspondence device, not its model topology.

typography.mathematics: Times New Roman, italic d and S; upright numeric subscripts
typography.editing: Native grouped text objects, not raster text or OMML
